REM ###########################################################################################
REM #                                                                                         #
REM # Title     : Linux Persistence Hunter                                                     #
REM # Author    : NullSec (bad-antics)                                                         #
REM # Version   : 1.0                                                                         #
REM # Category  : incident-response                                                            #
REM # Target    : GNU/Linux                                                                    #
REM #                                                                                         #
REM ###########################################################################################

REM Description: Hunts for persistence mechanisms commonly used by attackers on Linux.
REM Checks systemd services, init scripts, shell profiles, LD_PRELOAD hijacks,
REM PAM backdoors, kernel module loading, at jobs, XDG autostart, and more.
REM Designed for blue team / DFIR use.

DELAY 3000
CTRL-ALT t
DELAY 1500

STRING cat << 'NULLSEC_EOF' > /tmp/.nullsec_persist_hunt.sh
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING #!/bin/bash
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # NullSec Linux Persistence Hunter v1.0
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING RED='\033[0;31m'; YEL='\033[1;33m'; GRN='\033[0;32m'; CYN='\033[0;36m'; NC='\033[0m'
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING FINDINGS=0
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING REPORT="/tmp/nullsec_persistence_$(hostname)_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).txt"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log() { echo -e "$1" | tee -a "$REPORT"; }
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING finding() { FINDINGS=$((FINDINGS+1)); log "${RED}[!] FINDING #${FINDINGS}: $1${NC}"; }
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING info() { log "${CYN}[*] $1${NC}"; }
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log "============================================"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log " NullSec Persistence Hunter"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log " Host: $(hostname) | $(date -u)"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log "============================================"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log ""
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # 1. Systemd service/timer persistence
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING info "Checking systemd services for persistence..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING for dir in /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system ~/.config/systemd/user; do
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     CUSTOM=$(find "$dir" -name "*.service" -o -name "*.timer" 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING       grep -lE '(curl|wget|/tmp/|/dev/shm|python|perl|nc |ncat|bash -c|base64)' "$f" 2>/dev/null
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     done)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     if [ -n "$CUSTOM" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING       finding "Suspicious systemd unit files: $CUSTOM"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING       for f in $CUSTOM; do cat "$f" >> "$REPORT" 2>/dev/null; done
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING done
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Recently created systemd units
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING RECENT_UNITS=$(find /etc/systemd/system -type f -mtime -7 2>/dev/null)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING if [ -n "$RECENT_UNITS" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   finding "Recently created/modified systemd units (last 7 days):"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   echo "$RECENT_UNITS" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log ""
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # 2. Shell profile persistence
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING info "Checking shell profile files for persistence..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING PROFILES=".bashrc .bash_profile .profile .bash_login .bash_logout .zshrc .zprofile"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING for homedir in /root /home/*; do
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   for prof in $PROFILES; do
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     if [ -f "$homedir/$prof" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING       SUSPICIOUS=$(grep -nE '(curl|wget|nc |ncat |python.*-c|perl.*-e|base64|/dev/tcp|eval|exec.*<|\..*\..*\.|socat)' "$homedir/$prof" 2>/dev/null)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING       if [ -n "$SUSPICIOUS" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING         finding "Suspicious entry in $homedir/$prof:"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING         echo "$SUSPICIOUS" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING       fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   done
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING done
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log ""
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # 3. LD_PRELOAD hijacking
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING info "Checking for LD_PRELOAD hijacking..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING if [ -f /etc/ld.so.preload ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   PRELOAD_CONTENT=$(cat /etc/ld.so.preload 2>/dev/null)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   if [ -n "$PRELOAD_CONTENT" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     finding "LD_PRELOAD hijack detected in /etc/ld.so.preload:"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     echo "$PRELOAD_CONTENT" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING ENV_PRELOAD=$(env 2>/dev/null | grep LD_PRELOAD)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING if [ -n "$ENV_PRELOAD" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   finding "LD_PRELOAD set in environment: $ENV_PRELOAD"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log ""
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # 4. Init script persistence
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING info "Checking init scripts..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING RC_SUSPECT=$(find /etc/init.d /etc/rc.local /etc/rc*.d 2>/dev/null -type f -mtime -30 2>/dev/null)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING if [ -n "$RC_SUSPECT" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   log "  Recently modified init scripts:"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   echo "$RC_SUSPECT" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING if [ -f /etc/rc.local ] && [ -s /etc/rc.local ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   RCLOCAL=$(grep -vE '^(#|$|exit 0)' /etc/rc.local 2>/dev/null)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   if [ -n "$RCLOCAL" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     finding "Active commands in /etc/rc.local:"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     echo "$RCLOCAL" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log ""
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # 5. XDG Autostart
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING info "Checking XDG autostart entries..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING for dir in /etc/xdg/autostart ~/.config/autostart; do
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     AUTOSTART=$(find "$dir" -name "*.desktop" -mtime -30 2>/dev/null)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     if [ -n "$AUTOSTART" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING       log "  Recent autostart entries in $dir:"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING       for f in $AUTOSTART; do
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING         grep -H "Exec=" "$f" >> "$REPORT" 2>/dev/null
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING       done
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING done
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log ""
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # 6. At jobs
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING info "Checking at queue..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING ATJOBS=$(atq 2>/dev/null)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING if [ -n "$ATJOBS" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   finding "Active at jobs found:"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   echo "$ATJOBS" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log ""
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # 7. Unusual kernel modules
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING info "Checking for suspicious kernel modules..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Modules loaded from non-standard paths
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING OOT_MODULES=$(lsmod 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $1}' | while read mod; do
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   modpath=$(modinfo "$mod" 2>/dev/null | grep "^filename:" | awk '{print $2}')
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   if [ -n "$modpath" ] && ! echo "$modpath" | grep -qE '^/lib/modules/'; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     echo "$mod: $modpath"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING done)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING if [ -n "$OOT_MODULES" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   finding "Out-of-tree kernel modules detected:"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   echo "$OOT_MODULES" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log ""
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # 8. PAM configuration
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING info "Checking PAM configuration..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING PAM_SUSPECT=$(find /etc/pam.d -type f 2>/dev/null -exec grep -lE '(pam_exec|pam_script|pam_debug)' {} \;)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING if [ -n "$PAM_SUSPECT" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   finding "Suspicious PAM modules configured:"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   echo "$PAM_SUSPECT" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   for f in $PAM_SUSPECT; do grep -E '(pam_exec|pam_script)' "$f" >> "$REPORT" 2>/dev/null; done
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log ""
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # 9. Motd/update-motd persistence
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING info "Checking motd scripts..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING if [ -d /etc/update-motd.d ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   MOTD_SUSPECT=$(find /etc/update-motd.d -type f -mtime -7 2>/dev/null)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   if [ -n "$MOTD_SUSPECT" ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     log "  Recently modified motd scripts:"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING     echo "$MOTD_SUSPECT" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log ""
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Summary
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log "============================================"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING if [ "$FINDINGS" -gt 0 ]; then
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   log "${RED}[!] HUNT COMPLETE: $FINDINGS persistence mechanism(s) found!${NC}"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING else
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING   log "${GRN}[+] HUNT COMPLETE: No obvious persistence mechanisms detected.${NC}"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING fi
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log "Full report: $REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING log "============================================"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING NULLSEC_EOF
ENTER
DELAY 500

STRING chmod +x /tmp/.nullsec_persist_hunt.sh && bash /tmp/.nullsec_persist_hunt.sh && rm -f /tmp/.nullsec_persist_hunt.sh && exit
ENTER
